description: Exterior view of O'Keeffe's Abiquiu house with antlers over doorway and large native shrub in foreground, landscape, architecture;  O'Keeffe is walking in her yard, along the side of the house ( in the direction of the juniper dotted hills behind the wall of her house) with her back to the viewer. O'Keeffe is dressed in black with her hair pulled back in a braided crown at the nape of her neck.
title: North Courtyard
